**Newsletter: Introduction to Recycled Paper at Our Print Shop**

Dear Art Community,

Starting May 8th, our print shop will accept recycled paper. This is a significant step towards reducing our environmental impact and supporting sustainable practices. We encourage artists to bring samples for our testing.

The shift to recycled paper will be a new experience, so we want to ensure you are fully prepared. Bring a sample to our shop and let us know if you have any questions or concerns.

Thank you for your continued support and dedication to creating beautiful prints.

Best regards,
[Founder's Name]
